dossier.scp_unleashed.066.title: Eric's Toy
dossier.scp_unleashed.066.caption: SCP-066 at intake, calm, beside its evidence tag.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-066 is kept in a padded room furnished with soft toys and a low table. Staff may enter one at a time to collect treats for approved morale programmes, and must handle SCP-066 gently. **SCP-066 is never to be struck, kicked or harmed in any way.**
For transport, SCP-066 may be lifted by hand while calm. It winds itself into a tight ball of yarn, and unwinds again when set down.

If SCP-066 enters its second state, the room is to be sealed at once and all personnel are to withdraw beyond hearing range. Ear protection is mandatory for any later approach. **The second state is permanent.**

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-066 is a heap of thick yarn about a metre tall, wound in coils of red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple. It has no visible mechanism. It rolls slowly across the floor and plays short tunes from somewhere inside its coils, like a music box or a small set of bells.
When a person touches SCP-066 gently, it produces a wrapped sweet or a cupcake from among its coils. These are ordinary and safe to eat. It will not give the same person another for a short while.

If SCP-066 is struck by a person, it changes over about five seconds. Its yarn fades to grey, it shakes violently, six eyeballs push out from between its coils one after another, and the yarn turns a deep red. **The change cannot be undone.**
In its second state SCP-066 hunts any person it can see, rolling after them at speed. It strikes with considerable force, and every strike comes with a single, extremely loud musical chord.

page.title: Addendum 066-1: Test Log
text: Test 066-01: a researcher asked SCP-066 for a treat. It played four rising notes and produced a cupcake with a cherry on top.
Test 066-03: the researcher asked again at once. SCP-066 played two falling notes and gave nothing.
Test 066-05: SCP-066 was left alone overnight. Staff on the next shift reported humming from the room at all hours.
Test 066-07: a D-class subject was instructed to kick SCP-066. %rTest chamber 4 is no longer in use.%r

page.title: Addendum 066-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-066 has no recovery record. It was delivered to a reader of this file by the unidentified individual in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects, wound into a tight ball of yarn. The individual said only that it likes to be played with gently, and that it must never, ever be hit. See field notes.

jade.scp_unleashed.scp066.treat_ready: A treat is ready for you
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp066_ball.1: SCP-066 is a heap of rainbow yarn that rolls about playing little tunes. Use the ball on the ground to set it down; sneak-use the calm heap with an empty hand to wind it back up.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp066_ball.2: Right-click the calm heap for a treat: usually a candy, sometimes a cupcake. Each player can get one every %s seconds.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp066_ball.3: Hitting it even once starts a change: it turns grey, shakes, grows six eyes and turns red. The change is permanent. A hostile SCP-066 never calms down or gives treats again.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp066_ball.4: Hostile, it hunts players and D-class, rolling after them at speed. Each hit deals %s damage with a deafening chord. Turn off "SCP-066 loud music" in the mod's config screen to hear the chord at normal volume.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp066_ball.5: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-066 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A few minutes later a stranger delivers it, wound into a ball.
Spawns a calm SCP-066 with %s health. Treat it gently.
Striking it once makes it hostile for good.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp066_candy.1: A wrapped sweet from SCP-066. Restores %s hunger and is quick to eat, even when you are full.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp066_cupcake.1: A cupcake from SCP-066. Restores %s hunger and brings a little cheer: Regeneration for %s seconds.
